name: OnboardingForm
title: Blocks/Account/OnboardingForm
summary: The /signup/onboarding screen, frame included: the signed-out `GlobalHeader` over a two-column grid whose left column is a `Card` holding a `Wizard` (the step line, the step heading, the step's fields and the Cancel / Previous / Next footer, Next gated on the required answers), and whose right column, from `lg` up, is a wireframe of the app the new organization will open into. The three steps live in one component; each story here opens on one of them. Built from `Wizard`, `Field` with `Input`, `RadioGroup` with `variant="card"` in a `fieldset` under a `Field.Legend` with a `HelperText`, a `Field.Label` choice card around a `Switch`, `Tag`, `Avatar` and `Button`; picking a paid plan opens the upgrade `Drawer` with `ToggleGroup`, `Field` with `Input`, `Select` and `Checkbox`, `Link` and `Alert`. A full page routed outside ConsoleLayout.

variants.name: Plan
variants.summary: Step 2 of 3: the three plans as full-width rows; Free selects directly, while Pro or Enterprise opens the upgrade drawer (the `account/change-plan-drawer#Checkout` form, What's included as a `FeatureList`) and only selects once Upgrade is pressed.

variants.name: Profile
variants.summary: Step 3 of 3: the usage and role questions, the onboarding-session switch and the Create Organization action, which asks for both answers first.
